description: Broad combination with the order book read strictly before the origin: se7_lgbm_all's learner, params, derived sets and families, except that the v1 book family (sweep 1 of the origin's own pass, ~7 min after the capture, inside the direction label window; DESIGN_V1 section 21) is replaced by the book0 aux family (se-aux-book0-v1: newest complete sweep finished before the origin capture started, at most 3 h old, normally the previous pass's last sweep). Not embargoed (broad); promotion-eligible. Read against se1_lgbm_mm. Trains only when every labelled capture of the window has the book0 table.
